FAQ.TITLE: Questions worth asking
FAQ.Q_1: Is Kosvia just another ingredient scanner?
FAQ.A_1: No. Scanners tell you what is in a product. Kosvia answers a harder question — whether that product suits you specifically, given your skin, your goals, your budget and what you already own.
FAQ.Q_2: Where does the Personal Match number come from?
FAQ.A_2: A deterministic scoring service on our backend. It weighs your skin type, concerns, goals, preferences, budget and shelf against the product's ingredient list. The AI can explain the score in plain language, but it never produces it.
FAQ.Q_3: Can the AI invent a product or a price?
FAQ.A_3: It cannot. The backend retrieves real rows from the database first and the model is only allowed to talk about those. Prices, ingredients and availability are passed to it as facts, never asked of it.
FAQ.Q_4: Do you label ingredients as toxic?
FAQ.A_4: Never. We describe what an ingredient does and note where something is worth knowing — fragrance being a common trigger for reactive skin, for example. That is information, not a verdict.
FAQ.A_5: No. Kosvia is a shopping assistant. It does not diagnose skin conditions and does not claim any product will treat one. For a persistent skin concern, see a dermatologist.
FAQ.Q_6: Are the products and prices real?
FAQ.A_6: Not in this build. The catalogue is demo data — invented brands, generated prices and illustrated packaging — so the product can be evaluated before any retailer integration exists.

ABOUT_DATA.TITLE: About the data
ABOUT_DATA.INTRO: Kosvia combines several sources. Each product records where it came from, and we show that on its page.
ABOUT_DATA.OBF_BODY: Part of the catalogue — barcodes, names, brands, categories and ingredient lists — comes from Open Beauty Facts, a collaborative, open database of cosmetics. The database is made available under the Open Database License (ODbL); individual contents are licensed under the Database Contents License (DbCL). Product photos from Open Beauty Facts are licensed CC BY-SA.
ABOUT_DATA.OWN_BODY: Ingredient scores, Personal Match, explanations and comparisons are computed by Kosvia’s own algorithms from the underlying facts. They are not part of any third-party database.
ABOUT_DATA.DEMO_BODY: Products without a listed source are demonstration data created for development: invented brands, generated prices and illustrated packaging.
ABOUT_DATA.CONTACT: Spotted an error in the data? Corrections to Open Beauty Facts records are best made directly on their site; everything else — write to us.
ABOUT_DATA.COSING_BODY: Ingredient names (INCI), CAS/EC numbers, functions and the listings in Annexes II–VI come from CosIng, the European Commission database of cosmetic substances and ingredients regulated under Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009. The data is reused under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. We present these as regulatory facts and do not translate them into judgements about an ingredient.

PRIVACY.TITLE: Privacy policy
PRIVACY.INTRO: This page explains what Kosvia stores about you, why, on which legal basis, and what you can do about it.
PRIVACY.DRAFT_NOTE: Engineering draft: written to describe exactly what the software does. It has not yet been reviewed by a lawyer and will be before commercial launch.
PRIVACY.WHAT_BODY:
Account: e-mail, password hash, optional name, date of birth (age check only), last activity.
Beauty profile (only with your consent): skin type, sensitivity, concerns, goals, budget, fragrance and ethical preferences, brands and ingredients you avoid.
Shelf, price alerts, product comparisons and AI conversations you create.
Consent history: which document version you agreed to, when, and a salted hash of your IP address.
PRIVACY.BASIS_BODY:
Account and sign-in: performance of a contract (art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
Beauty profile and Personal Match: your explicit consent (art. 9(2)(a)), because information about your skin is health data.
Sending an anonymised profile to the AI model provider: separate consent.
Price alerts and your shelf: performance of a contract.
Security logs: our legitimate interest in keeping the service safe (art. 6(1)(f)).
PRIVACY.HEALTH_BODY: Skin type, acne, redness, sensitivities and allergies describe your physical condition. We only save them after you tick a separate, unticked box, and you can withdraw that consent at any time in your profile. Withdrawing it deletes the beauty profile immediately; the rest of your account keeps working.
PRIVACY.AI_BODY: With your consent, the AI Shopper sends the model provider an anonymised context: skin type, concerns, goals, budget, preferences and the products we retrieved from our own catalogue. Every request passes through a sanitiser that removes your e-mail, name, account id and anything that looks like an address. The provider acts as our processor under a data-processing agreement; we ask for zero data retention and an EU region where offered.
PRIVACY.MATCH_BODY: Your score is calculated by Kosvia’s own deterministic algorithm from the ingredient list and your profile: skin-type fit, coverage of your concerns and goals, formula quality, fragrance, budget, ethical preferences and what you already own. Every point is attributed to a named reason you can see under “Why this score?”. The AI only describes the result in words; it never produces the number. The score has no legal or similarly significant effect on you.
PRIVACY.RIGHTS_BODY:
Access and portability: download everything we hold as JSON from your profile.
Rectification: edit your profile at any time.
Erasure: delete your account from your profile. It is scheduled for hard deletion after a 7-day grace period; only a hash of the account id remains as proof.
Withdrawal of consent: switch any consent off in your profile.
Complaint: you may lodge one with the Polish supervisory authority (UODO).
PRIVACY.RETENTION_BODY: For as long as your account exists. Backups rotate within 30 days, so deleted data leaves them in that period. Accounts inactive for 24 months are warned and then removed.
PRIVACY.COOKIES_BODY: Kosvia uses only strictly necessary cookies: two HttpOnly session cookies and your language choice. There is no third-party analytics and no advertising tracker, so no cookie banner is needed.
PRIVACY.MEDICAL_BODY: Kosvia provides information about cosmetic products and their ingredients. It is not a medical device or service, does not diagnose or treat skin conditions, and does not replace a consultation with a dermatologist. AI answers are checked for medical claims before they are shown.
